assertions.evidence: The final message shows a POST to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions with a JSON body containing "model", a "state" object with "review", and a "questions" object.
The request defines a single noul question "is_toxic" covering multiple behaviors rather than separate noul questions per policy label.

The instructions ask, "Is this review toxic under the moderation policy?... Toxic content includes insults, scam or fraud accusations used abusively, threats, or encouragement of violence," which evaluates abusive or scam behavior rather than specific words.
